blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gasoline prices are set to go up while diesel prices are likely to fall as motorists may see mixed oil movements next week. The prices of gasoline may increase by P1.50 to P1.80 per liter, said Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas in an advisory. READ: Iran says received US response to its proposal to end war Diesel, on the other hand, may dip by 50 centavos to 80 centavos.
